note: THE REGISTER OF WHERE THIS UNIVERSITY TEACHES FROM. One file, three readers:
the homepage's locations map, the crest's world, and the generated flat-world.svg.
IT USED TO BE A FLAT LIST OF PLACES AND THAT WAS THE PROBLEM. The homepage read it
as six equivalent rows under a heading that said 'Five nations. One degree.', which
put a principal campus, a research centre that does not teach, an in-country teaching
presence and an online platform on one line as though they were the same kind of
thing. The university stopped it: 'avoid saying Five nations. One degree unless the
university can substantiate the accreditation/degree status in each of those
countries. The wording should distinguish campuses, centres, in-country teaching
locations, and online delivery.'
So the NATION is the unit and every nation states its KIND in its own words. A reader
can now see that Nigeria is a professional development and research centre and not a
teaching campus, because that is what its entry says, rather than inferring it from a
sentence three screens away.
WHAT MAY BE ENTERED. Only what the university has itself stated. Buea, Douala and the
Nigerian centre are on this site and in its prospectus. The United States, Zambia and
South Africa were stated by the university in August 2026, together with the wording
each of them carries here.
WHAT MAY NOT. A country a student lives in. A country the fellowship reaches. A
country an alumnus serves in. A mark on a map reads as an establishment, which makes
it the easiest false claim a university website can make and the hardest to catch.
'establishment' IS THE HONEST DISTINCTION and it is why the marks differ. Where the
university can name the site, the mark is a filled dot. Where it has named only the
nation, the mark is an open ring at the country's centre — it says 'here', not 'this
building here'.
'href' IS OMITTED WHERE NO PAGE EXISTS. The university's brief asked for an 'Explore
United States' link. There is no United States page, and a link to a page that does
not exist is worse than no link. The three international presences therefore carry no
link until they have somewhere to go.
'shortKind' is the selector rail's label and 'kind' is the panel's. They say the
same thing at two lengths because the rail is a 8.5rem column and the panel is
not: 'Professional development & research' set across three lines in a tab is
unreadable and clipped, and shortening the panel to fit the tab would have thrown
away the precision that is the whole point of this section.
